title: Daniel Ek backs AI researcher’s fusion power startup. Here’s what they’re building.
lede: Europa Fusion, a UK startup founded in February by former DeepMind and Pacific Fusion machine learning researcher Nantas Nardelli, has Spotify founder Daniel Ek as a backer.

points: Nardelli previously worked at Google DeepMind, Facebook AI Research and Microsoft Research Cambridge, and led machine learning at Pacific Fusion.
Like Pacific Fusion, Europa will pursue pulsed power, which compresses fuel targets with precisely timed surges of current.
A source says Nardelli favours leaning on simulation and data over the heavy hardware testing most fusion startups rely on.
No fusion plant has yet delivered electricity to the grid.
Nardelli says climate change drove his move out of AI; Bloomberg first reported Ek's investment.

sections.text: It tests whether machine learning and simulation can replace some of the costly hardware iteration in fusion, a field also pitched as an answer to AI's power demand.
